condition: 2D, f* 0.3, depth 5, L 200, N 1000, seed 1, frictionless engine 765c1f0, Gamma 1.8 to 3.0 in steps of 0.05; the three frictionless ramps of E0052 rerun with tools/field_recorder.py. One seed: calibration, no transition point is a result.

recorder_changes_nothing.how: every array of each step's checkpoint.npz and quantities.npz compared with np.array_equal against the same step of E0052 (run without the recorder); frames recorded must be 32 per cycle plus one and their times equal the referee's

recorder_acted.note: 32 frames per cycle plus the frame at the start of each hold

resume_check.run: 2D, Gamma 2.5, f* 0.3, N 1000, L 200, seed 1, 60 cycles, checkpoint every 7; stopped by a CPU cap in cycle 41 with 180 recorded frames later than its last checkpoint (cycle 35), then resumed
resume_check.result: all arrays of fields.npz and of the final checkpoint equal those of an uninterrupted 60-cycle run
resume_check.note: run in sequel-data/tmp and deleted; repeatable from the commands in the session record

band_amplitude.definition: A_raw (the amplitude registered in E0053) = sqrt of the time-mean over all frames of a hold of the height-field variance in Fourier modes 3 to L/8 of the box (bins of 2 D). In the step tables A is the noise-corrected amplitude adopted afterwards (D0035) and A_first, A_second its halves.

registered_test_on_100_cycle_loop.verdict: first clause holds (7.9); second clause fails narrowly (0.509 against 0.5)

transition_rule_note: Computed with the rule as finally fixed (plan section 5; noise-corrected amplitude, robust flat level, tolerance max(5 s, 0.1 D)) to show it can be applied; one seed, frictionless: calibration, not a result.
